name: Webform Simplify
description: Simplifies the Webform user interface by hiding certain parts, and gates the webform settings screens behind granular per-section permissions.
provides_plugin_types: webform_simplify.element (WebformSimplifyElement) — declares, per Webform element type, which tabs/features/property fields and conditional-logic options can be hidden
project_description: Webform Simplify allows certain parts of the Webform user interface to be hidden so the build and settings screens present a smaller, less intimidating surface to content editors. It can hide Webform's help sections, hide individual fields/tabs/conditional-logic options on element edit forms (config-driven, per element type, via a WebformSimplifyElement plugin per element), and hide or restrict parts of the webform settings screens (confirmation types, form-settings sub-tabs, submissions sub-tabs, and access-form roles/users/permissions controls). Separately it rewrites the access requirements on the core webform settings and handler routes so each settings section is gated by its own granular permission (edit any webform general/form/submission/confirmation/asset/access/handler settings), in addition to Webform's existing webform.update entity access. Users with the administrator role or user 1 bypass all simplification unless 'Simplify for super users' is enabled; other trusted roles can be granted 'Bypass webform simplification'.
